name: kaleido
description: Kaleido (万象) - 面向生态推演的多智能体环境仿真引擎

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.dev: npm run backend:stable && npm run frontend:stable
scripts.dev:status: npm run backend:stable:status && npm run frontend:stable:status
scripts.dev:restart: npm run backend:stable:restart && npm run frontend:stable:restart
scripts.dev:stop: npm run frontend:stable:stop && npm run backend:stable:stop
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.verify: npm run verify:backend && npm run build && npm run test:space-forecast
